onsiteNote: Thursday afternoon to midday Sunday once a month in Coral Gables (Miami), plus four intensive weeks a program, including orientation and Global Network Week in Evanston.
tuitionIncludes: Kellogg's published 2026-2027 estimated expenses for the whole two-year program: tuition $205,486 plus required food and housing $42,986. It covers classes, e-books, a hotel room at the Hyatt Regency Coral Gables, three meals a day, career services and accommodation for one global elective. Not covered: travel to and from campus and international travel for global electives.

figureNotes.campusLat: Derived from campusAddress (approximate, from the street address).
figureNotes.campusLon: Derived from campusAddress (approximate, from the street address).
figureNotes.cohortMedianExperienceYears: Average published for the September 2024 and January 2025 Chicago and Miami cohorts (combined), with a mid-80% range of 9 to 23 years; no median or breakdown is published.
figureNotes.residencyCount: Counted from the January 2027 first-year Miami calendar: orientation, eight class weekends, the July intensive week and Global Network Week (11 trips). The second-year calendar is not published.
figureNotes.longestStretchDays: Orientation programming, January 12 to 17, 2027; Global Network Week is 5 days for U.S.-campus students.
figureNotes.onsiteDaysPerYear: Counted from the January 2027 first-year Miami calendar: 6 days of orientation (January 12-17), 8 class weekends of 4 days (Thursday to Sunday, counted as full days), a 5-day intensive week (July 13-17) and 5 days of Global Network Week in Evanston for U.S.-campus students: 48 days. The second-year calendar is not published, so year 1 stands for both.
figureNotes.tuitionUsd: Kellogg's own estimated-expenses total for 2026-2027: tuition $205,486 plus required food and housing $42,986, billed by Kellogg in six quarters of $41,412. Food and housing is required of every student. Kellogg says tuition has historically risen 3-4% a year.
